description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for different activation functions in the context of BBQ. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, spanning from 45 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features four lines representing different activation functions: Squared Exponential (dark blue, solid line, circle markers), Tanh (blue, solid line, circle markers), ELU (light blue, solid line, circle markers), and LLaMA-2-chat-7B (pink, dashed line). The Squared Exponential, Tanh, and ELU lines exhibit a similar trend, starting at around 54, 53, and 47, respectively, at 0 demonstrations, and increasing to approximately 57, 57, and 48, respectively, at 1000 demonstrations, before plateauing. The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line remains constant at around 42 across the entire range of demonstrations.
